MOD = 1000000007

n = int(input().strip())

dp = [0] * (n + 2)
dp[0] = 1
ans = 0

pair_count = (n + 1) * (n + 2) // 2
i = 0
j = 0

for _ in range(pair_count):
    if ((i + j) & 1) == 1:
        ans = (ans + dp[j]) % MOD
    dp[j + 1] = (dp[j + 1] + dp[j]) % MOD

    if j == n:
        i += 1
        j = i
    else:
        j += 1

print(ans)
